## Validation

- [ ] I ran `pytest`.

## Public research boundary

- [ ] No credentials, private memory, private datasets, raw forensic payloads, local databases, or machine-specific secrets are included.
- [ ] Any new mechanism is explicitly documented as validated, experimental, or proposed.
- [ ] Claims in documentation are proportional to the evidence in this repository.

Note any API, numerical, dependency, or reproducibility impact.
